title: HV battery temperature sensor fault: swap test to separate sensor from circuit

applies_to.scope_note: General method for packs that have more than one identical temperature sensor. No specific make or model was named.

claims.text: When the battery controller reports deviation or open circuit on a temperature sensor and the pack has several sensors, swap the suspect sensor with one that has no fault.
If the fault moves with the sensor, the sensor is faulty.
If the fault stays at the same position, the problem is in the circuit (wiring, connector) or in the control module.
A substitute sensor can replace a faulty one if it fits mechanically and matches electrically (sensor type, resistance curve, readings). Confirm with live data before relying on it.
claims.note: We only have the assistant's summary; the expert's own words are not in the file.

claims.text: Locate the suspect sensor and its position from live data before opening the pack.
For a deviation fault, compare under similar thermal conditions, because real temperature differences between positions affect the result.

safety.qualification: Technician qualified to open and work inside high-voltage battery packs
warnings: Work inside a high-voltage battery. Isolate the pack and verify zero voltage before touching sensors or wiring.
Swap only sensors that are identical and interchangeable in that pack design.

open_questions: On which vehicles has he used the swap test?
